name: PBQ Santa Cruz 92.2 FM 2026

venue.name: Radio Santa Cruz
venue.address: Av. Mariano Saucedo Sevilla esquina, Güendá 20, Santa Cruz de la Sierra

information:
This is the first Please Be Quiet competition held in the country, taking place at a radio station, marking a unique and innovative event where participants face a different kind of challenge one where control, focus, and silence are the keys to standing out. This competition is open to all public.
To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74436-informacion-de-pago)
 
**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ]      (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74434-faq-pmf)**

Esta es la primera competencia Please Be Quiet celebrada en el país, realizada en una emisora de radio, marcando un evento innovador y único que reúne a participantes en un desafío diferente, donde el control, la concentración y el silencio son la clave para destacar. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico.
Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74436-informacion-de-pago)

**Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQSantaCruz922FM2026#74434-faq-pmf)**
